value.rationale: A natural fixed-permutation disjunctive cellular automaton on a cycle has a sharp and mathematically motivated finite-time invariant: its largest number of full sweeps before occupation. The result not only realizes the obvious distance bound, but characterizes all extremal schedules, uniquely locates their slow source, and gives their superfactorially small proportion. These structural and exact combinatorial distinctions are not furnished by mere convergence or entropy assertions.
